name: Night at the Office
storyline:
Joseph Anadam was found at the bottom of the elevator bank at the Emerging Group Lp, a death where nobody yet knows the true cause. It is now nighttime and you are working late at the office trying to get some extra work done. Throughout the night, you begin experiencing headaches and phenomenon which begin to tie many causes to Joseph’s death.

Who killed Joseph Anadam and why are you the one who is being put through the terrors of uncovering his death?
summary: Experience Night at the Office, a walking simulator, puzzle horror game focused on placing you into the heart of an environment full of terror, suspense and surprise. Night at the Office focuses on delivering a story-rich murder mystery coupled with many horror elements to make the experience far more exciting.
